cards.name: Vacation Bible School
cards.description: Children learn about God's creation through a Genesis-themed Vacation Bible School. Central Baptist participates with First Presbyterian of Spruce Pine, Trinity Episcopal, and Spruce Pine United Methodist Church.
cards.review_notes: Dates and evening format were stated in indexed official SPUMC bulletin text, which initially listed the location as to be determined. A later NewsBreak article, 'God’s Creation from Genesis VBS at Spruce Pine UMC,' identifies SPUMC as the host; verify the final venue in the July 2026 church newsletter, whose download returned no readable text. The venue address is published on SPUMC's official website. First Presbyterian's official VBS page confirms the 2026 event and Central Baptist's participation but was readable only through search results. No 2026 ages, grades, prices, or registration opening were verified; 2025 details were not carried forward.
